description:
This protocol moves up to 384 samples from 1 source plate to 1 destination plate using a P50-multichannel GEN1 pipette. The source plate is a Greiner Bio-One 384-well plate, and the destination plate can be either a Corning 384-well plate or a Bio-Rad 384-well plate. Samples are transferred across row A (A1, C1, E1, G1, I1, K1, M1, O1; A2, C2, E2, G2, I2, K2, M2, O2; etc.), then across row B (B1, D1, F1, H1, J1, L1, N1, P1; B2, D2, F2, H2, J2, L2, N2, P2; etc.).


To purchase tips, reagents, or pipettes, please visit our online store or contact our sales team at info@opentrons.com

Opentrons OT-2
Opentrons OT-2 Run App (Version 4.0.0 or later)
Opentrons P50 Multi-Channel Pipette GEN1
Opentrons 96 Tiprack 300ul
Greiner Bio-One 384 Well Plate 100 µL #781720
Corning 384 Well Plate 20 µL #4511
Bio-Rad 384 Well Plate 50 µL #HSR4801

For more detailed information on compatible labware, please visit our Labware Library.
